profile.headline: Software Developer In Test at Sprint
profile.summary:
Expertise in writing SELENIUM WebDriver automation scripts in JAVA for web applications.
Design framework for automation using SELENIUM.
Hands on experience in designing automation scripts using JAVA and WEBDRIVER.
Hands on experience in designing framework using MAVEN.
Personal skills include excellent communication and effective time management and have the ability to work in a team as well as independently.

positions.title: Software Developer In Test
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Gather Business requirements and develop the test plan, test scenarios and test cases. 
•	Prepared Test Plan, test Cases, Test scripts, Type Script and Test data for the application.
•	Involved in the error checking and testing of the ETL programs using Informatica session log and workflow logs.
•	Involved in ETL Mapping Design and Performance tuning to Load mapping process.
•	Developed automation framework using Selenium WebDriver in Java using TestNG and Data Driven from scratch on different browser versions (IE, Firefox, Chrome, and Safari). Used TestNG framework for the Unit, Regression and Sanity tests.
•	Wrote test automation script, executed and maintained test automation project using Eclipse IDE.
•	Created Maven Project to add dependencies in the project object model (POM).
•	Used TOAD for Oracle in creating & executing SQL queries for testing ETL process.
•	Developed test automation framework for web application and automated regression test requirements. Functional library and reusable component development in TOSCA test suite and HP-QC integration.
•	Developed automation scripts and extracted data from excel sheets using Apache POI library (i.e. Data Driven).
•	Used Page object model (POM) and created object repository in POM using Page Factory, and Maven build, a build automation tool.
•	Expertise in grouping of Test suites, Test cases and Test Methods for Regression and Functional Testing using TestNG Annotations like Groups, Parameter, Data Provider and Tags.
•	Responsible to handle Securities and Derivative project’s FIX protocol testing and TOSCA test automation on Regression and UAT test phases
•	Perform Regression testing on new builds and every modification in the application using Selenium WebDriver.
•	Knowledgeable of SQL, Ruby on Rails, JIRA, Testrail, WMOS Super User and Cognos

positions.title: Software Developer In Test
positions.description:
Project Description: 
Centura Health is a non-profit, faith-based health care system based in Centennial, Colorado which was formed in 1996 as a joint operating agreement between Catholic Health Initiatives and Adventist Health System.

positions.title: QA/SDET
positions.description:
Project Description:
Nokia Networks (formerly Nokia Solutions and Networks (NSN) and Nokia Siemens Networks (NSN)) is a multinational data networking and telecommunications equipment, and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Nokia Corporation.
•	Nokia Siemens Networks deals with equipment of the latest technologies in GSM, with platform ranging from BSS, as well as Transmission.

positions.title: QA Automation
positions.description:
•	Understanding the User Requirement Document.
•	Analyzing of test requirements and test scenarios and Creating manual Test cases
•	Involved in the designing of manual test cases.  
•	Responsible for writing automation scripts, Execution of Test cases, and publishing test results.
•	Developed Scripts using VBScript language for Automating Testing Activity in QTP
•	Generated Test Data for Automation Scripts in Excel from QTP
•	Good Experience in Waterfall Methodology Process for the product development
•	Performed Database Validation Testing using complex SQL queries using Inner/Outer joins
•	Used the HP Quality Center (QC) defect tracking system, to report and analyze defects during the entire testing process
•	Tested application API in Azure cloud environment using Swagger.
•	Designed, maintained and executed Automated Integration framework of API/Web Services across multiple test and production environments using SOA test
•	Created custom JSON/XML Assertors, for validation of SOAP (WSDL), and REST API calls, and Data Banks for storing and analyzing data input/output and error codes
•	Preparing and executing Test cases, Review test cases and Defect Reporting
•	Prepared Defect Report as per severity and Priority
•	Analyzed Test specifications and written Manual Test cases for Black Box Testing
•	Performed manual testing using Cross-browser and Cross-Platform
•	Involved in Defect Reporting Meetings daily
•	Analyzing the results, updating the status.
•	Raising Defects in the JIRA tool, retesting, and closing the Defects.
•	Testing Tickets as well as Enhancements.
•	Reported quality of database information after running SQL queries.

positions.title: QA Automation/Java
positions.description:
•	Performed tool evaluation to identify the right tool for the application.
•	Involved in preparing test automation POC and demonstrated to all stakeholders.
•	Involved in identifying the scope for test automation.
•	Performed Structural Testing, Functional Testing and Non-functional Testing, Database Testing.
•	Developed the automated test script for regression, parallel test suite in an application by using the Selenium tool and configured thread count and groups for each test case.
•	Developed Selenium scripts to find, verify, select, edit, and perform various operations on web elements. Used Select class to perform operations on the dropdown list.
•	Involved in designing the architecture of web application using JSP, Servlets and Core Java 
•	Developed Selenium scripts to get the data from the webpage by using methods like getting Text, getTitle, getAttribute.
•	Used Selenium WebDriver API with TestNG to automate tests on the cross-browser and cross-platform environments. 
•	Implemented Selenium Synchronization for Conditional and Un-Conditional waits using Implicit Waits and Explicit Waits. 
•	Performed browser (IE, FIREFOX, Chrome, Safari) and platform (Windows 7/8/XP) compatibility testing in the virtual machine environment. 
•	Wrote Selenium script for taking a screenshot and used Actions class to perform Mouse and Keyboard events.
